1. [Home][2]
[An automation engineer working in a high-tech facility, viewing a digital AI robot assistant
overlay on a screen alongside technical code and 3D CAD models.]

# What if AI could do an engineer’s most tedious work?

We’ve launched the Eigen Engineering Agent, purpose-built AI for industrial automation engineering.
It moves AI beyond generating suggestions to executing engineering tasks end-to-end. Now available
for more than 600,000 TIA Portal users.

[Start free trial][3][How AI transforms Engineering][4]
[CES 2026: Roland Busch & Jensen Huang, Siemens & NVIDIA]

## Building the operating system for Industrial AI

Together with NVIDIA, we are building the Industrial AI operating system for the physical world.
Read the latest news from our ever-expanding partnership here.

[Learn more][5]
[Vectron X Primary - Tec Keyvisual 16to9]

## Vectron X – the next dimension of rail technology

The next generation of locomotives for freight and passenger transport combines the proven platform
technology with app-based functionalities, open interfaces for third-party providers, in an open
ecosystem – connecting people, places and portfolios more closely than ever before.

[Read more][6]
[bx-overview-panoramic-city-skyline-is485896260-xcelerator-shape-hero-2560x1440]

## One digital twin, clear operational insight

At the University of Wollongong, a digital twin brings together data from 1,000 assets, 500 BMS
points, energy meters and documents, to create a single source of truth and enable efficient,
data-driven operations acrossthe campus.

[Explore Building X][7]
[Amazonia rainforest]

## A digital twin in the Amazon rainforest

Deep in the Amazon, a cooperative partnered with Natura to extract essential oils from native
plants. We brought a digital twin to their extraction process, cutting energy and water use while
boosting income for the local community by 60%.

[Read the story][8]
[A person wearing a headset interacts with a holographic display of 3D models and data
visualizations.]

### Realize LIVE 2026 | Global events

Wabtec is a leading global provider of equipment, systems, digital solutions, and value-added
services. Whether it's freight rail, transit, mining, industrial or marine, our expertise,
technologies, and people - together - are accelerating the future of transportation.

For 14 years, Wabtec Girls Camp has inspired young girls to explore STEM through hands-on

## Rewiring Europe’s Freight Rail for a Digital Future

As Europe's freight rail industry advances toward a more connected future, digital technologies are
creating new opportunities to improve safety, efficiency, and reliability. Daniel Gradl, President
of Brakes & Couplers at Wabtec explores how telematics, Digital Automatic Couplers (DAC),
intelligent yard operations, and industry collaboration are helping drive this transformation.

## Improved Air Quality for the Paris RER A line

On the RER A, the busiest line in the Paris region, RATP is taking steps to improve air quality with
Green Friction. Developed by Wabtec, this innovative braking solution helps significantly reduce
particulate emissions, making a real difference in underground and closed environments where it
matters most.

## Decarbonizing Global Transport

### A Better Future: Our Shift to Green

Safer. Smarter. Cleaner. Greener.

[ See how we are committed to sustainable transportation solutions [Continue reading] ][151]
[ FLXdrive Homepage Slide Feature]

## Up to 30% Fuel & Emissions Savings

### FLXdrive™ Battery Electric Locomotive

Over the last year, Wabtec took a bold step toward a low-to-zero-emission locomotive future with the
world’s first heavy-haul 100-percent battery-electric locomotive – called FLXdrive™. The locomotive,
powered by approximately 20,000 battery cells, was tested in revenue operation across more than
13,320 miles of hilly terrain in San Joaquin Valley, California.

Operating in a consist between two other locomotives and with a battery capacity of 2.4 megawatt
hours, FLXdrive successfully reduced overall fuel consumption by more than 11 percent — the
equivalent to over 6,200 gallons of diesel fuel saved and approximately 69 tons of CO2 emissions
reduced.

The next version of FLXdrive is currently in development and expected to be ready for market in
2023. With a battery capacity of more than 7 megawatt hours, we anticipate further reducing fuel
consumption and emissions by up to 30 percent.

[ Learn more about FLXdrive™ Battery Electric Locomotive Read more [Continue reading] ][152]
[Wabtec: Innovating with Purpose]

## Improving Air Quality

### Next Generation Friction Technology

Wabtec’s Green Friction technology is the result of the Company’s expertise in friction materials
and significant investments in the methodology of measuring the particles emitted during braking.

Over the past year, this technology has undergone rigorous testing with Paris region operator, RATP,
and has proven its ability to reduce particle emissions from friction braking on metro trains by up
to 90 percent. RATP and Wabtec have equipped two trains that operate on one of the busiest lines in
Europe with this new technology for a final pilot. This technology represents a significant
milestone on the journey towards cleaner tunnels for passengers and network personnel.

[ Learn more about Next Generation Friction Technology Read more [Continue reading] ][153]
[Wabtec Port Optimizer]

## Increasing throughput & improving efficiency

### Port Optimizer™

Wabtec is increasing port throughput and improving efficiency with Port Optimizer™, a cloud-based
software initiative integrating data from across the port ecosystem. It helps the supply chain
monitor and respond to dynamic conditions, align people and resources, and proactively communicate
across functions – enabling maximum port throughput and delivery performance.

Not only does Port Optimizer™ improve efficiencies - it provides an opportunity for ports to
differentiate themselves from their competitors. The timely sharing of accurate information about
container moves, status changes, asset management, etc. across all port stakeholders is needed to
better plan for operations. As a neutral party, Port Authorities can be the driving force to create
a Digital Infrastructure for the collection, aggregation and standardization of data flowing through
the port and to make that data readily available through APIs and various applications.

Wabtec is a leading global provider of equipment, systems, digital solutions, and value-added
services. Whether it's freight rail, transit, mining, industrial or marine, our expertise,
technologies, and people - together - are accelerating the future of transportation.

For 14 years, Wabtec Girls Camp has inspired young girls to explore STEM through hands-on

## Rewiring Europe’s Freight Rail for a Digital Future

As Europe's freight rail industry advances toward a more connected future, digital technologies are
creating new opportunities to improve safety, efficiency, and reliability. Daniel Gradl, President
of Brakes & Couplers at Wabtec explores how telematics, Digital Automatic Couplers (DAC),
intelligent yard operations, and industry collaboration are helping drive this transformation.

On the RER A, the busiest line in the Paris region, RATP is taking steps to improve air quality with

particulate emissions, making a real difference in underground and closed environments where it
matters most.

## Decarbonizing Global Transport

### A Better Future: Our Shift to Green

Safer. Smarter. Cleaner. Greener.

[ See how we are committed to sustainable transportation solutions [Continue reading] ][151]
[ FLXdrive Homepage Slide Feature]

## Up to 30% Fuel & Emissions Savings

### FLXdrive™ Battery Electric Locomotive

Over the last year, Wabtec took a bold step toward a low-to-zero-emission locomotive future with the
world’s first heavy-haul 100-percent battery-electric locomotive – called FLXdrive™. The locomotive,
powered by approximately 20,000 battery cells, was tested in revenue operation across more than
13,320 miles of hilly terrain in San Joaquin Valley, California.

Operating in a consist between two other locomotives and with a battery capacity of 2.4 megawatt
hours, FLXdrive successfully reduced overall fuel consumption by more than 11 percent — the
equivalent to over 6,200 gallons of diesel fuel saved and approximately 69 tons of CO2 emissions
reduced.

The next version of FLXdrive is currently in development and expected to be ready for market in
2023. With a battery capacity of more than 7 megawatt hours, we anticipate further reducing fuel
consumption and emissions by up to 30 percent.

[ Learn more about FLXdrive™ Battery Electric Locomotive Read more [Continue reading] ][152]
[Wabtec: Innovating with Purpose]

## Improving Air Quality

### Next Generation Friction Technology

Wabtec’s Green Friction technology is the result of the Company’s expertise in friction materials
and significant investments in the methodology of measuring the particles emitted during braking.

Over the past year, this technology has undergone rigorous testing with Paris region operator, RATP,
and has proven its ability to reduce particle emissions from friction braking on metro trains by up
to 90 percent. RATP and Wabtec have equipped two trains that operate on one of the busiest lines in
Europe with this new technology for a final pilot. This technology represents a significant
milestone on the journey towards cleaner tunnels for passengers and network personnel.

[ Learn more about Next Generation Friction Technology Read more [Continue reading] ][153]
[Wabtec Port Optimizer]

## Increasing throughput & improving efficiency

### Port Optimizer™

Wabtec is increasing port throughput and improving efficiency with Port Optimizer™, a cloud-based
software initiative integrating data from across the port ecosystem. It helps the supply chain
monitor and respond to dynamic conditions, align people and resources, and proactively communicate
across functions – enabling maximum port throughput and delivery performance.

Not only does Port Optimizer™ improve efficiencies - it provides an opportunity for ports to
differentiate themselves from their competitors. The timely sharing of accurate information about
container moves, status changes, asset management, etc. across all port stakeholders is needed to
better plan for operations. As a neutral party, Port Authorities can be the driving force to create
a Digital Infrastructure for the collection, aggregation and standardization of data flowing through
the port and to make that data readily available through APIs and various applications.

# Your Global CDMO

As a global CDMO headquartered in Munich, Germany, we are committed to fulfilling the pharmaceutical
needs of clients throughout Europe, Japan and North America. Our approach is rooted in a
customer-centric philosophy that guarantees exceptional quality and service in every aspect.

## [Our Offering][112]

We are a reliable CDMO partner, providing comprehensive Development and Manufacturing services for
drug products, from small molecules to large molecules. We offer end-to-end services for your small
molecule finished dosage forms (FDFs), including sterile and non-sterile liquids, solids, and
semi-solids products, and we are also specialised in biologicals, orphan drugs, clinical trials,
fill-and-finish, and lyophilisation.

out-licensing and supply to one-off analysis, custom developments, and advanced formulation
services.

][115]

### Clinical Manufacturing

][117]

We guide your project through every phase of clinical manufacturing, from feasibility studies and
pre-clinical material preparation to **GMP-compliant production**. Our end-to-end approach ensures
seamless transitions between phases, delivering high-quality solutions tailored to your clinical
needs.

supply chain management to regulatory affairs, for your drug product.

Do you want to book **Bangladesh Railway tickets online**? If so, our website
[BDRailwayticket.com][15] can be very helpful for you. By providing the necessary information on our
website, you can easily take advantage of the railway ticket booking service. You can also find
detailed information on how to purchase railway tickets as well as various updates and news about
Bangladesh Railway from our website.

Rail travel in Bangladesh has always been one of the most popular, affordable, and comfortable ways
to move across the country. Every day, Bangladesh Railway serves millions of passengers with
reliable train services. Thanks to modern technology, you no longer need to stand in long queues at
the station—now you can easily book your Bangladesh Railway ticket online.

## Bangladesh Railway Ticket Booking Online (বাংলাদেশ রেলওয়ে টিকেট বুকিং)

You can book Bangladesh Railway tickets through the website, mobile app, or directly from the
railway station. By using any of these three methods, you can easily complete your train ticket
booking.

### Official E-Ticketing System

You can book train tickets directly through this website, the official Bangladesh Railway Ticket
Website, or even via [Shohoz][16]. The official online ticketing portal for Bangladesh Railway is
[https://eticket.railway.gov.bd][17]. However, you don’t need to visit that site separately, as you
can book your tickets directly from this page as well.

The process is very simple: first, search for your desired train by entering your travel details.
Next, log in to your account (or register if you are a new user). After that, choose your preferred
seat or class and proceed to payment. Once your payment is successful, you will receive your
e-ticket instantly, which you can download or keep on your smartphone for a hassle-free journey.
Steps:
* **Search Trains:** Enter your departure station, destination, journey date, and class.
* **Login or Register:** Login or Create an account using your email and mobile number.
* **Choose Your Ticket:** Check available trains, fares, and seats, then select your preferred
  option.
* **Make Payment:** Pay securely through bKash, Nagad, Rocket, Upay, or Visa/MasterCard.
* **Download Ticket:** Once payment is successful, your ticket will be emailed to you. You can also
  download it from the “Purchase History” section of your account.

## Rail Sheba Mobile App

The official Rail Sheba App is available for both Android and iOS users. Benefits include:
* Easy ticket booking and payment
* Manage previous and upcoming reservations
* Download e-tickets directly from the app
* Real-time train location tracking

### Station Counter Booking

If you prefer offline booking, you can visit your nearest railway station and purchase tickets with
cash. Intercity tickets should be booked in advance, while local and commuter train tickets are sold
a few hours before departure.

## Step by Step Bangladesh Railway Ticket Booking Online

Follow these simple steps to book your Bangladesh Railway e-ticket quickly—no station queue, no
hassle.

**Quick learning:** 1) Search train → 2) Log in / Register → 3) Pick coach & seats → 4) Enter
passenger details → 5) Pay securely → 6) Download e-ticket

Go to the Railway e-ticket system website: **BDRailwayTicket.com, eticket.railway.gov.bd or
shohoz.com**. Or use the Rail Sheba mobile app (Android/iOS). If you’re on bdrailwayticket.com, use
the search tool there—it routes you to the official system to complete purchase.

## Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

### Can I change my ticket after booking?

Yes. Ticket modification can be done at the station counter with a small fee, depending on
availability.

### What if I lose my ticket?

For e-tickets, simply log in to your account and re-download.

### What happens if I travel without a ticket?

You will be fined, usually double the fare amount.

# Our innovation sets standards

CITI, INC specializes in the production of software and hardware solutions for sophisticated,
industrial automation applications—both commercially and for government entities. With an expertise
in the design and manufacturing of custom control solutions, our company spans across three
permanent offices located in the Carolinas. With a staff of more than 50 highly trained
professionals, we strive not only to deliver reliable, innovative tech solutions, but also pride
ourselves on our continued success stemmed from high-quality workmanship and individualized care for
each customer’s integration projects. If you live in North or South Carolina, there is an extremely
good chance that the water and waste management services you utilize daily are delivered and
maintained in part to the efforts of CITI, INC!

## Capabilities

[A close up of the lines on a map]

### Control Systems Integration Solutions

From “concept design” to “system installation” and everything in between, CITI offers control
integration solutions that fit all our client’s needs. In addition to our capabilities of developing
industrial-grade PLC and SCADA software solutions that will keep your facility running, we also
offer in-house UL certified panel construction services. Allow us to be your one-stop-shop to
achieving fully-automated process control.
* SCADA Development
* Control Design
* PLC Programming
* Panel Fab/UL Listed Shop

[ Learn More ][19]

[A row of computer servers in a room.]

### Network Solutions

Professionally maintained networking architecture and high-speed communications are essential for
reliable and instantaneous feedback on how your facilities’ processes are performing. Our customers
know and trust our aptitude for high-quality network design, ranging from local fiber-optic
communications to long-rang telemetry solutions. CITI will always deliver your ideal networking
solution to cover both large and small projects. We’ll oversee the design and installation of the
new systems and network upgrades to ensure they satisfy all the needs of your operations and
management teams.
* Network Design
* Cyber Security
* Telemetry
* Fiber Optic Networking

[ Learn More ][20]

[A man working on electrical equipment in an industrial setting.]

High-Quality service and support is the backbone of any reliable system. CITI's work doesn’t stop
after installation: our top-tier engineering support teams are standing by to provide
around-the-clock protection, ensuring that you can rest easy knowing that local, in-person support
is just a phone-call away. We are passionate about the work and services we provide, and we know
just how important it is that customers feel that abundant confidence that CITI is renowned for.
* System Maintenance
* Emergency Service/Support
* Instrumentation Calibration
* Energy Management
* Inventory Management

[ Learn More ][21]

# ETECH TECHNOLOGY CENTERIndependent Electronics Laboratory
# for Testing, Analysis & EMC

Supporting electronics manufacturers with failure analysis, XRF measurements, cross-sectioning,
solderability testing and EMC investigations.

Independent testing and analysis for PCBs, components, cables and electronic assemblies.
[Request a quote][20]
[Our laboratory][21]
[https://novalab.bold-themes.com/lab-s/wp-content/uploads/sites/9/2020/06/home_hero_detail.jpg]

### Core Laboratory Capabilities

Independent testing and analysis to support quality, reliability and failure investigations in
electronics.
[XRF Analysis]

### XRF Analysis

XRF analysis is used to verify material composition, surface finishes and plating thickness of
electronic components and PCBs.
[Cross-Section Analysis]

### Cross-Section Analysis

Cross-section analysis provides insight into internal structures, layer build-up and plating quality
of PCBs and assemblies.
[Solderability Testing]

### Solderability Testing

Solderability testing assesses the ability of components and PCB surfaces to form reliable solder
joints.
[EMC Testing]

### EMC Testing

EMC testing assesses electromagnetic compatibility and identifies potential interference issues in
electronic products.
[Contamination Diagnostics]

### Contamination Diagnostics

Contamination diagnostics identifies residues and surface contamination that may affect reliability
and long-term performance.

# Do you have a quality issue or need independent analysis?

We support electronics manufacturers with testing and analysis when quality issues arise, materials
need to be verified, or failures need to be investigated.

From initial inspection to detailed analysis, we help identify root causes and provide clear,
independent reporting.
* Product failures without a clear root cause
* Doubts about material quality or plating thickness
* Solderability issues affecting production yield
* EMC interference or compliance concerns
* Need for independent verification or reporting

[Get Your Project Evaluated][22]

We respond within 24 hours with a clear next step

### WHY WORK WITH USWhy manufacturers rely on ETECH Technology Center

Your independent lab partner for electronics reliability

We provide independent, technical insight when quality and reliability are at stake.
* Independent, objective analysis
* Fast turnaround with clear next steps
* Strong expertise in electronics manufacturing
* Trusted by manufacturers across Europe

[Discuss your case with us][23]

### BENEFITSWhy manufacturers choose ETECH Technology Center

#### Independent & Objective Analysis

We provide unbiased, independent insight — no production influence, no hidden interests.

#### Deep Electronics Expertise

Years of hands-on experience in electronics manufacturing, testing and failure analysis.

#### Fast Response & Clear Next Steps

We respond quickly and tell you exactly what to do next — no delays, no uncertainty.

#### Actionable & Reliable Reports

Clear reporting you can actually use — not just data, but decisions.

### Independent analysis and reliability testing for electronics

[[https://novalab.bold-themes.com/lab-s/wp-content/uploads/sites/9/2020/04/service_5.jpg]][24]

##### [Materials & PCB Analysis][25]

[[https://novalab.bold-themes.com/lab-s/wp-content/uploads/sites/9/2020/04/service_6.jpg]][26]

##### [Failure Analysis][27]

[[https://novalab.bold-themes.com/lab-s/wp-content/uploads/sites/9/2020/04/service_7.jpg]][28]

##### [EMC & Reliability Testing][29]

### TESTIMONIALSWhat our customers say about working with ETECH

ETECH clearly explained the testing process, required samples and expected results. Their analyses
are precise and the reports are reliable for our customers.
**Jeroen Mooijekind**
MACH Technology

# Bangladesh Railway – The Lifeline of National Transportation

Bangladesh Railway is the **largest government-owned transport system in Bangladesh**, serving
millions of passengers and businesses every year. With an extensive network spanning over **3,000
kilometers of rail lines**, it connects major cities, towns, and even remote regions of the country.
The railway system is not only an **affordable and reliable mode of transport for daily commuters**
but also a vital link for trade, tourism, and national development.

Whether you are traveling for work, leisure, or sightseeing, Bangladesh Railway provides a **safe,
convenient, and economical way to explore the country**.

## Advantages of Traveling by Train in Bangladesh
* **Cost-Effective Transportation:** Train tickets are generally cheaper than buses or private cars,
  ideal for budget-conscious passengers and families.
* **Comfortable Long-Distance Journeys:** Trains provide more legroom, reclining seats, sleeper
  arrangements, and onboard restrooms, ensuring a comfortable journey.
* **Eco-Friendly Transport:** Trains produce less carbon emissions per passenger compared to road
  vehicles and flights.
* **Reduced Traffic Hassle:** Passengers avoid heavy traffic jams common on highways.
* **Safe and Secure Travel:** Train journeys are statistically safer than road transport, and some
  trains provide female-only compartments and onboard security.

## Online Train Ticket Booking in Bangladesh

Bangladesh Railway offers **e-ticketing** to save passengers from long queues. Tickets can be booked
through the [official website][39] or authorized mobile apps.

### Steps to Book E-Tickets Online
1. Visit the [official Bangladesh Railway ticketing website][40].
2. Register with your **mobile number and email address**.
3. Select your **departure station, destination, travel date, and train name**.
4. Choose your **seat type** (Shovan, Shovan Chair, First Class, AC, Sleeper, etc.).
5. Make payment using **mobile banking (bKash, Rocket, Nagad)** or bank card.
6. Download or print your **e-ticket** and show it during boarding.

## Train Schedules & Popular Routes

Bangladesh Railway operates hundreds of trains daily. Some popular and busy routes include:
* **Dhaka to Chattogram:** Subarna Express, Mahanagar Godhuli Express
* **Dhaka to Sylhet:** Parabat Express, Jayantika Express
* **Dhaka to Rajshahi:** Silk City Express, Dhumketu Express
* **Dhaka to Khulna:** Sundarban Express, Chitra Express
* **Dhaka to Rangpur/Dinajpur:** Rangpur Express, Ekota Express

## Train Ticket Prices in Bangladesh

Ticket prices vary depending on distance, train type, and seat class:
* **Shovan Seat (Economy):** Cheapest option
* **Shovan Chair:** Comfortable seating with extra legroom
* **First Class:** Spacious cabins with better facilities
* **AC Sleeper:** Premium comfort with sleeping arrangements for overnight journeys

## Travel Tips for First-Time Passengers
* Book tickets early during high-demand periods like Eid, Puja, or school holidays.
* Keep digital and printed copies of your e-ticket for verification.
* Arrive at the station at least 30–45 minutes before departure.
* Carry a small lock for luggage security.
* Bring snacks and water for long journeys.
* Check train schedules regularly as timings may change.

## Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)
* **Q1: How can I book Bangladesh Railway tickets online?** You can book tickets via the official
  e-ticket portal or authorized mobile apps.
* **Q2: Can I buy tickets from station counters?** Yes, traditional counters are available at all
  major stations.
* **Q3: What documents are required for online booking?** A valid mobile number and
  NID/passport/driving license may be required.
* **Q4: How early should I book tickets during Eid or holidays?** Book as soon as sales open,
  usually 5–10 days before travel.
* **Q5: Can I change or cancel my ticket?** Yes, according to Bangladesh Railway’s refund policy.
  Partial refunds may apply.
* **Q6: Are trains safe for solo female passengers?** Yes, some trains have female-only
  compartments.
* **Q7: What happens if I miss my train?** Tickets become invalid; a new ticket must be purchased.
* **Q8: Do children need separate tickets?** Children under 3 travel free; ages 3–12 pay reduced
  fares.
* **Q9: Is Wi-Fi available on trains?** Some intercity trains provide Wi-Fi; availability is
  limited.
* **Q10: Can I carry luggage on trains?** Yes, extra charges may apply if weight limits are
  exceeded.

# Bangladesh Railway – The Lifeline of National Transportation

Bangladesh Railway is the **largest government-owned transport system in Bangladesh**, serving
millions of passengers and businesses every year. With an extensive network spanning over **3,000
kilometers of rail lines**, it connects major cities, towns, and even remote regions of the country.
The railway system is not only an **affordable and reliable mode of transport for daily commuters**
but also a vital link for trade, tourism, and national development.

Whether you are traveling for work, leisure, or sightseeing, Bangladesh Railway provides a **safe,
convenient, and economical way to explore the country**.

## Advantages of Traveling by Train in Bangladesh
* **Cost-Effective Transportation:** Train tickets are generally cheaper than buses or private cars,
  ideal for budget-conscious passengers and families.
* **Comfortable Long-Distance Journeys:** Trains provide more legroom, reclining seats, sleeper
  arrangements, and onboard restrooms, ensuring a comfortable journey.
* **Eco-Friendly Transport:** Trains produce less carbon emissions per passenger compared to road
  vehicles and flights.
* **Reduced Traffic Hassle:** Passengers avoid heavy traffic jams common on highways.
* **Safe and Secure Travel:** Train journeys are statistically safer than road transport, and some
  trains provide female-only compartments and onboard security.

## Online Train Ticket Booking in Bangladesh

Bangladesh Railway offers **e-ticketing** to save passengers from long queues. Tickets can be booked
through the [official website][39] or authorized mobile apps.

### Steps to Book E-Tickets Online
1. Visit the [official Bangladesh Railway ticketing website][40].
2. Register with your **mobile number and email address**.
3. Select your **departure station, destination, travel date, and train name**.
4. Choose your **seat type** (Shovan, Shovan Chair, First Class, AC, Sleeper, etc.).
5. Make payment using **mobile banking (bKash, Rocket, Nagad)** or bank card.
6. Download or print your **e-ticket** and show it during boarding.

## Train Schedules & Popular Routes

Bangladesh Railway operates hundreds of trains daily. Some popular and busy routes include:
* **Dhaka to Chattogram:** Subarna Express, Mahanagar Godhuli Express
* **Dhaka to Sylhet:** Parabat Express, Jayantika Express
* **Dhaka to Rajshahi:** Silk City Express, Dhumketu Express
* **Dhaka to Khulna:** Sundarban Express, Chitra Express
* **Dhaka to Rangpur/Dinajpur:** Rangpur Express, Ekota Express

## Train Ticket Prices in Bangladesh

Ticket prices vary depending on distance, train type, and seat class:
* **Shovan Seat (Economy):** Cheapest option
* **Shovan Chair:** Comfortable seating with extra legroom
* **First Class:** Spacious cabins with better facilities
* **AC Sleeper:** Premium comfort with sleeping arrangements for overnight journeys

## Travel Tips for First-Time Passengers
* Book tickets early during high-demand periods like Eid, Puja, or school holidays.
* Keep digital and printed copies of your e-ticket for verification.
* Arrive at the station at least 30–45 minutes before departure.
* Carry a small lock for luggage security.
* Bring snacks and water for long journeys.
* Check train schedules regularly as timings may change.

## Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)
* **Q1: How can I book Bangladesh Railway tickets online?** You can book tickets via the official
  e-ticket portal or authorized mobile apps.
* **Q2: Can I buy tickets from station counters?** Yes, traditional counters are available at all
  major stations.
* **Q3: What documents are required for online booking?** A valid mobile number and
  NID/passport/driving license may be required.
* **Q4: How early should I book tickets during Eid or holidays?** Book as soon as sales open,
  usually 5–10 days before travel.
* **Q5: Can I change or cancel my ticket?** Yes, according to Bangladesh Railway’s refund policy.
  Partial refunds may apply.
* **Q6: Are trains safe for solo female passengers?** Yes, some trains have female-only
  compartments.
* **Q7: What happens if I miss my train?** Tickets become invalid; a new ticket must be purchased.
* **Q8: Do children need separate tickets?** Children under 3 travel free; ages 3–12 pay reduced
  fares.
* **Q9: Is Wi-Fi available on trains?** Some intercity trains provide Wi-Fi; availability is
  limited.
* **Q10: Can I carry luggage on trains?** Yes, extra charges may apply if weight limits are
  exceeded.
* **Q11: Are food and drinks available?** Many intercity trains have pantry cars or onboard
  catering.
* **Q12: Does Bangladesh Railway operate cargo services?** Yes, it also transports goods across the
  country.

#### IRCTC Train Ticket Booking FAQs

**Q)** Why should I book train tickets with Tripozo?
**A)** Tripozo provides train alternates and IRCTC ticket confirmation prediction to assist you to
get confirm IRCTC tickets online. In addition, information like Live Train Status, Historical
Running Status of train, Confirmation Probability for waitlist PNR & more. Tripozo (formerly
etrain.info) is your one stop solution for everything related to Indian Railways Information and
train bookings.
**Q)** How many people can I book in a single train ticket booking?
**A)** You are allowed to book upto 6 passengers on a single train ticket booking. For tatkal train
ticket booking, the maximum number is 4 persons per booking. Two children below 5 years are allowed
per booking, but not ticketed.
**Q)** What are the meaning of RAC, GNWL, PQWL, RLWL and TQWL in Railway Reservation?
**A)** There are multiple waitlist status for IRCTC train ticket booking, refer [detailed
explanation][24] to know more about waitlist and abbrevations used in IRCTC ticket booking.
**Q)** For how many days in advance can you book train tickets?
**A)** Advance Reservation Period (abbrevated as ARP) for booking train tickets is 60 days
(excluding the date of journey).
**Q)** What documents are required while booking IRCTC train tickets online?
**A)** Indian passengers are not required any ID details while booking. However, passengers of other
countries are required to input their Passport number while booking IRCTC train tickets online.
During the journey, all passengers must carry at least one valid ID, like, Aadhar card, driving
license, pan card, voter id card, etc.
**Q)** Can I travel without printout and show train ticket on mobile?
**A)** Yes, An M-ticket will be sent post booking, which helps you save paper without having to take
printouts. Upon checking you can show M-Tickets.
**Q)** Will I get a refund on cancellation?
**A)** Tripozo provides INSTANT REFUND on IRCTC tickets cancellations. Refund amount shall be
automatically credited to the user’s account used at the time of booking. Visit [Refund Rules][25]
for more details about cancellation charges and refund rules.

# Driving Connectivity & Charging

GRL is a global leader in engineering services for
digital connectivity and charging technologies

## 2000+

Customers globally across wide range of industries

## 200+

Global Team Members

## 9+

Global Locations and Expanding

## **Standards Certification & Compliance**

##### Official compliance testing and logo certification programs across multiple industry standards

[USB ATL]

#### USB & Power Delivery

USB4, USB 3.2, USB 2.0 compliance, certification, interoperability and Power Delivery (PD) testing
[Learn More][56]
[2-May-19-2026-05-23-06-2253-PM]

#### Thunderbolt™

World's first Thunderbolt Certified Lab by Intel & Apple since 2012. Full certification for
Thunderbolt 3, 4 & 5 systems and devices across Windows and macOS
[Learn More][57]
[HDMI]

#### HDMI Certification

Official HDMI logo certification and compliance testing for source, sink, and cable products
[Learn More][58]
[DisplayPort]

#### DisplayPort

Leading contributing lab for DP compliance test development. DP 1.4, DP Alt Mode, DP 2.0 / DP40 /
DP80 logo certification, pre-compliance and debug for sources, sinks, cables & hubs
[Learn More][59]
[PCIe]

#### PCI Express

Independent testing including PVT testing, pre-compliance and custom testing for PCIe electrical,
link, and protocol layers
[Learn More][60]
[Apple MFi]

#### Apple MFi

MFi certification testing services for Made for iPhone/iPad/iPod product validation
[Learn More][61]
[Matter]

#### Matter / Thread / Zigbee

CSA Matter, Zigbee and Thread Group certification and pre-compliance testing for smart home devices
[Learn More][62]
[official qi and qi2 wireless charging certification logos]

#### Qi Wireless Charging

Authorized Test Lab for WPC Qi logo certification including BPP/EPP, authentication, Qi 2.2 (25W)
and automotive moving coil technology
[Learn More][63]
[nccslogo2 - Edited-1]

#### NCCS & EU RED

 NCCS-designated Telecom Security Testing Laboratory (TSTL) for OLT, ONT, IP Routers & Wi-Fi CPEs,
enabling MTCTE certification for the Indian market, along with EU RED compliance support for
seamless entry into European markets. 
[Learn More][64]

### [and many more...][65]

 

## A Comprehensive Suite of Testing Services

[checklist]

#### Standards Certification & Compliance

Official compliance testing and logo certification for USB, HDMI, and other standards. Independent
testing for PCIe, IEEE 802.3, DDR, MIPI, and more.

[usb-c-cable]

#### Cable & Connector Testing

Comprehensive electrical testing for cables and connectors, ensuring mechanical and electrical
compliance across USB-A, USB-C, and other form factors.

[interoperability]

#### Interoperability & Design Robustness

Broad device interoperability testing across ecosystems. Catch design weaknesses early and ensure
your products work seamlessly across real-world conditions.

[Power Integrity]

#### Signal & Power Integrity

Advanced signal and power integrity analysis to identify and resolve high-speed design issues before
they reach production. Expert-led test and analysis workflows.

[microchip]

#### Silicon Characterization

IC characterization and SerDes tuning services for silicon and semiconductor products. We work with
IP, FPGA prototypes, and early silicon — not just mature products.

[testing]

#### Debugging, Consulting & Training

R&D and field-level debugging support, consulting from seasoned veterans, and hands-on training
programs. Extend your team's capability with GRL expertise.

Advanced signal and power integrity analysis to identify and resolve high-speed design issues before

IP, FPGA prototypes, and early silicon — not just mature products.

[testing]

#### Debugging, Consulting & Training

R&D and field-level debugging support, consulting from seasoned veterans, and hands-on training
programs. Extend your team's capability with GRL expertise.

# **ISO**: Global **standards **for trusted goods and services

Standards define **what great looks like**, setting consistent benchmarks for businesses and
consumers alike — ensuring **reliability**, **building trust**, and **simplifying choices**.

*Making lives easier, safer and better.*

## What can standards **do for you**?

International standards ensure that the products and services you use daily are **safe**,
**reliable**, and of **high quality**. They also guide businesses in adopting **sustainable **and
**ethical practices**, helping to create a future where your purchases not only perform excellently
but also safeguard our planet. In essence, standards seamlessly blend quality with conscience,
enhancing your everyday experiences and choices.

### What is a standard?

Dive deep into the world of quality and consistency.

**[Learn about standards][48]**

### Buy an ISO standard

Discover the standards that shape our world. 

**[Visit the store][49]**

### Looking to get certified?

together to agree on the best ways of doing things. From [quality management][51] to [AI][52], our

# **ISO**: Global **standards **for trusted goods and services

Standards define **what great looks like**, setting consistent benchmarks for businesses and
consumers alike — ensuring **reliability**, **building trust**, and **simplifying choices**.

*Making lives easier, safer and better.*

## What can standards **do for you**?

International standards ensure that the products and services you use daily are **safe**,
**reliable**, and of **high quality**. They also guide businesses in adopting **sustainable **and
**ethical practices**, helping to create a future where your purchases not only perform excellently
but also safeguard our planet. In essence, standards seamlessly blend quality with conscience,
enhancing your everyday experiences and choices.

### What is a standard?

Dive deep into the world of quality and consistency.

Environmental performance is no longer a side issue – it’s a strategic priority shaping decisions at
every level. As pressures mount from climate risks, regulation and stakeholder expectations,
organizations face a clear challenge: turning environmental ambition into measurable results. ISO
14001:2026 is designed to meet that need.

### [How quantum computers work][68]

Quantum computers don’t resemble the devices we’re used to? They tap into the strange world of
quantum mechanics to solve problems way faster than classical computers. In this article, we’ll
unpack the basics, look at how quantum processors compute, and explore the different types of
systems in development today.

### [Transport futures: Powering the next generation of mobility][69]

Mobility is changing faster than at any point in history. Behind it all sits a powerful convergence
of intelligence, automation and connectivity, reshaping how people and goods move through the world.

  # CREATING SOLUTIONS

## Wir bieten Elektroniklösungen für Mobilität

ACTIA IME GmbH mit Sitz in Braunschweig ist ein Unternehmen der global
agierenden[ ACTIA-Gruppe][110]. Seit 1986 entwickeln wir innovative Lösungen in den Bereichen
Fahrzeugkommunikation, Werkstattdiagnose, Energiespeicher- und -managementtechnik sowie
elektronische Steuerungen.
Mit mehr als 4.000 Mitarbeitern weltweit haben wir uns als zuverlässiger Partner der
Automobilindustrie etabliert. 

[ Über uns ][111]

1986

Gründung ACTIA

29

Standorte weltweit

+ 4000

Mitarbeiter*innen

## Unsere Expertise

Unsere langjährige Expertise bildet das Fundament für maßgeschneiderte Lösungen mit höchster
Präzision und Zuverlässigkeit. Von der ersten Idee bis zur Serienproduktion bieten wir umfassende
Leistungen, die durch exzellenten Service und persönlichen Support ergänzt werden.

## Unsere Märkte

### PKW

Seit über 30 Jahren stellen wir unsere Fähigkeit unter Beweis, und bieten unseren Kunden innovative
und maßgeschneiderte Lösungen – insbesondere im Bereich der Fahrzeugdiagnose.

[Mehr über PKW][124]

### Nutzfahrzeuge

Ob im städtischen Linienverkehr, im Fernreisebereich, im Schwerlasttransport oder im kommunalen
Einsatz – ACTIA bietet intelligente Systemlösungen für verschiedenste Fahrzeugtypen.

[Mehr über Nutzfahrzeuge][125]

### Off-Highway

Unsere umfassende Branchenerfahrung verbunden mit einem internationalen Netzwerk erlaubt es uns,
umfassende Systemlösungen für die extremen Bedingungen im Off-Highway-Bereich zu entwickeln und zu
produzieren.

[Mehr über Off-Highway][126]

### Schienenverkehr

ACTIA bietet Railway-Herstellern und Betreibern Lösungen in vier Hauptbereichen an: Komfort und
Ausstattung, Sicherheit, Kommunikationstechnologien, sowie Fahrzeugverfügbarkeit.

[Mehr über Schienenverkehr][127]

### Elektromobilität

Das elektrisch unterstützte Fahrrad hat sich in den letzten Jahren zu einem der beliebtesten
Fortbewegungsmittel entwickelt. Entdecken Sie unsere Elektromobilität-Systeme und sichere,
nachhaltige Lösungen.

[Mehr über Elektromobilität][128]

  # CREATING SOLUTIONS

## Wir bieten Elektroniklösungen für Mobilität

ACTIA IME GmbH mit Sitz in Braunschweig ist ein Unternehmen der global
agierenden[ ACTIA-Gruppe][110]. Seit 1986 entwickeln wir innovative Lösungen in den Bereichen
Fahrzeugkommunikation, Werkstattdiagnose, Energiespeicher- und -managementtechnik sowie
elektronische Steuerungen.
Mit mehr als 4.000 Mitarbeitern weltweit haben wir uns als zuverlässiger Partner der
Automobilindustrie etabliert. 

[ Über uns ][111]

1986

Gründung ACTIA

29

Standorte weltweit

+ 4000

Mitarbeiter*innen

## Unsere Expertise

Unsere langjährige Expertise bildet das Fundament für maßgeschneiderte Lösungen mit höchster
Präzision und Zuverlässigkeit. Von der ersten Idee bis zur Serienproduktion bieten wir umfassende
Leistungen, die durch exzellenten Service und persönlichen Support ergänzt werden.

## Unsere Märkte

### PKW

Seit über 30 Jahren stellen wir unsere Fähigkeit unter Beweis, und bieten unseren Kunden innovative
und maßgeschneiderte Lösungen – insbesondere im Bereich der Fahrzeugdiagnose.

[Mehr über PKW][124]

### Nutzfahrzeuge

Ob im städtischen Linienverkehr, im Fernreisebereich, im Schwerlasttransport oder im kommunalen
Einsatz – ACTIA bietet intelligente Systemlösungen für verschiedenste Fahrzeugtypen.

[Mehr über Nutzfahrzeuge][125]

### Off-Highway

Unsere umfassende Branchenerfahrung verbunden mit einem internationalen Netzwerk erlaubt es uns,
umfassende Systemlösungen für die extremen Bedingungen im Off-Highway-Bereich zu entwickeln und zu
produzieren.

[Mehr über Off-Highway][126]

### Schienenverkehr

ACTIA bietet Railway-Herstellern und Betreibern Lösungen in vier Hauptbereichen an: Komfort und
Ausstattung, Sicherheit, Kommunikationstechnologien, sowie Fahrzeugverfügbarkeit.

[Mehr über Schienenverkehr][127]

### Elektromobilität

Das elektrisch unterstützte Fahrrad hat sich in den letzten Jahren zu einem der beliebtesten
Fortbewegungsmittel entwickelt. Entdecken Sie unsere Elektromobilität-Systeme und sichere,
nachhaltige Lösungen.

[Mehr über Elektromobilität][128]

### [iPasslabs 開始提供PCIe® 5.0 32.0 GT/s 官方驗證服務][60]

作者： mkt • June 12, 2026
市場上仍有許多產品持續部署於 PCIe® 5.0
平台，也越來越多產品重視驗證階段，更能證明其效能的可信度跟產業競爭力。
為協助客戶加速驗證流程、不受限於時間地點，身為 PCI-SIG®認證實驗室的 iPasslabs，現正式擴展 PCIe® 5.0
32.0 GT/s 官方驗證服務能力。 自 2025 年正式成為亞洲第一家 PCI-SIG® 認證實驗室，iPasslabs 已提供
PCIe® 4.0 與 PCIe® 5.0（最高至 16.0 GT/s）官方驗證服務。如今，我們進一步支援 PCIe® 5.0 32.0 GT/s
正式驗證測試，協助客戶從 Pre-test 到 Official Compliance Test更順利完成驗證流程。 同時，PCIe® 6.0
也正式進入官方認證時代。自 PCI-SIG® Compliance Test Workshop #140 起，PCIe® 6.0
產品報名官方認證測試。然而，在正式認證之前，Pre-test重要性比以往更加關鍵。PCIe® 6.0 導入PAM4
訊號技術，大幅提高驗證複雜度，對於訊號完整性、互通性以及測試 know-how 都提出更高要求。
憑藉豐富的客戶 DUT 正式驗證支援以及參與 PCI-SIG Compliance Workshop現場測試的實務經驗，iPasslabs
擅長協助客戶降低開發風險、提升認證效率，加速產品上市。
[
][61]

### [iPasslabs 正式加入 IBTA!][62]

作者： mkt • June 12, 2026
在人工智慧快速發展下，資料中心進化為支撐生成式 AI、大規模模型訓練與高速推論的「算力工廠」。
隨著網路互連架構由 400G、800G 持續邁向 1.6T，高速互連（High-Speed
Interconnect）已成為影核心關鍵。如何確保高速網路互通性、訊號完整性與系統穩定性的品質，已成為產業升級
的重要課題。 秉持專業精神，iPasslabs 自今年起正式加入 IBTA（InfiniBand Trade
Association）技術生態系，並於今年 6 月參與 43rd InfiniBand™ and RoCE Plugfest，作為投入高速
Scale-Out Networking 技術驗證的起點。未來將積極參與 InfiniBand、RoCE、Ethernet 與 Scale-Out Network
架構相關技術研討、Plugfest等活動，加速建立AI 網路驗證能力。 憑藉多年高速介面驗證經驗，iPasslabs
提供涵蓋
Ethernet、InfiniBand、光通訊與電性整合測試的完整解決方案，從訊號完整性（SI）模擬分析、Pre-Test 與
正式Interoperability驗證，協助客戶有效降低設計風險、突破高速傳輸瓶頸、縮短開發時程並加速產品上市。且
作為 IEEE、PCI-SIG 與 IBTA 的會員及工作小組參與者，iPasslabs
長期實際參與國際技術標準推進與生態合作，嚴格依循協會規範與最新測試要求，提供值得信賴的一站式驗證服務
。 在這場AI 基礎設施競賽中，iPasslabs 致力成為客戶最可靠的高速互連驗證夥伴，攜手產業迎向 AI Data
Center 的新世代挑戰。
[
][63]

### [iPasslabs 與 BitifEye 宣佈達成策略合作夥伴關係，為高速訊號介面提供全球授權測試實驗室服務][64]

作者： mkt • October 13, 2025
此次合作專注於 PCI Express® 和 MIPI A-PHY® 一致性測試，為全球客戶群提供官方認證驗證服務。
艾飛思科技（iPasslabs Technology Co. Ltd.）與 BitifEye Digital Test Solutions
GmbH共同宣佈建立策略合作夥伴關係，攜手擴大服務範圍，為全世界提供高速訊號介面的官方認證測試服務。為滿
足全球 AI 和 智慧汽車（Smart Vehicle） 生態系統日益增長的需求，此次合作初期將專注於 PCI Express 和
MIPI A-PHY，並計劃在未來擴展至 USB®、IEEE/OIF 及其他新興技術。
透過結合雙方在測試系統開發、自動化和測試服務方面的互補專長，該合作夥伴關係將透過兩家公司的全球網絡提
供正式的認證測試服務。總部位於德國的 BitifEye 與總部位於臺灣的 iPasslabs
將共同推動全球業務發展，提供認證測試實驗室 (ATL) 服務。 iPasslabs 共同創辦人兼執行長 Eric Shen
表示：「為回應全球人工智慧技術的趨勢，我們很榮幸能宣佈這項合作，它將打破地域限制，為雙方創造雙贏局面
。透過與 BitifEye 的合作，我們現在能夠接觸並為更廣泛的歐洲客戶提供 PCIe 測試服務。同時，藉由
BitifEye 的專業知識和優勢，我們也能使 iPasslabs 的測試服務更加全面，從而提升公司的價值。」
在維持最高技術標準的條件下，此次合作為擴大專業能力範疇奠定了堅實的基礎，並克服了以往的限制。客戶將受
益於：更快的上市時間

I協會的認可，值得信賴。 BitifEye 執行長兼共同創辦人 Alexander Schmitt 表示：「與 iPasslabs
的合作使我們能夠服務更多的全球客戶。BitifEye iPasslabs Test Services Europe
GmbH是雙方共同新成立且聯合經營的測試實驗室，位於德國Böblingen，並結合 iPasslabs
在亞太地區的據點，使我們能夠為全球的 PCI Express 和 MIPI A-PHY
的需求提供高品質的測試解決方案和專業知識。」 關於BitifEye BitifEye 數位測試解決方案有限公司成立於
2005
年，總部位於德國斯圖加特附近，是高速訊號介面實體層接收器測試領域公認的市場領導者。該公司提供專業的自
動化測試解決方案，並積極參與定義最新互連訊號技術的國際標準化委員會。 BitifEye 開發的 ValiFrame
測試自動化軟體和相關的測試配件，可與 Keysight Technologies (是德科技) 的儀器無縫整合。BitifEye 和
Keysight
共同提供高度自動化的應用特定測試系統，被半導體和消費電子公司以及獨立測試實驗室使用。BitifEye
深入理解數位匯流排標準，並提供適用於 PCI Express®、Serial ATA®、SAS、USB®、HDMI®、DisplayPort®、MIPI
M-PHY®、MIPI D-PHY®、MIPI C-PHY®、UFS®、汽車乙太網 (Automotive Ethernet)、MIPI A-PHY®
等的一致性和相容性測試產品。 BitifEye 是歐洲唯一經授權可提供 PCIe 4.0 和 5.0
一致性測試的認證實驗室，此服務是與 iPasslabs 合作提供。

### [iPasslabs 開始提供PCIe® 5.0 32.0 GT/s 官方驗證服務][60]

作者： mkt • June 12, 2026
市場上仍有許多產品持續部署於 PCIe® 5.0
平台，也越來越多產品重視驗證階段，更能證明其效能的可信度跟產業競爭力。
為協助客戶加速驗證流程、不受限於時間地點，身為 PCI-SIG®認證實驗室的 iPasslabs，現正式擴展 PCIe® 5.0
32.0 GT/s 官方驗證服務能力。 自 2025 年正式成為亞洲第一家 PCI-SIG® 認證實驗室，iPasslabs 已提供
PCIe® 4.0 與 PCIe® 5.0（最高至 16.0 GT/s）官方驗證服務。如今，我們進一步支援 PCIe® 5.0 32.0 GT/s
正式驗證測試，協助客戶從 Pre-test 到 Official Compliance Test更順利完成驗證流程。 同時，PCIe® 6.0
也正式進入官方認證時代。自 PCI-SIG® Compliance Test Workshop #140 起，PCIe® 6.0
產品報名官方認證測試。然而，在正式認證之前，Pre-test重要性比以往更加關鍵。PCIe® 6.0 導入PAM4
訊號技術，大幅提高驗證複雜度，對於訊號完整性、互通性以及測試 know-how 都提出更高要求。
憑藉豐富的客戶 DUT 正式驗證支援以及參與 PCI-SIG Compliance Workshop現場測試的實務經驗，iPasslabs
擅長協助客戶降低開發風險、提升認證效率，加速產品上市。
[

### [iPasslabs 正式加入 IBTA!][62]

作者： mkt • June 12, 2026
在人工智慧快速發展下，資料中心進化為支撐生成式 AI、大規模模型訓練與高速推論的「算力工廠」。
隨著網路互連架構由 400G、800G 持續邁向 1.6T，高速互連（High-Speed
Interconnect）已成為影核心關鍵。如何確保高速網路互通性、訊號完整性與系統穩定性的品質，已成為產業升級
的重要課題。 秉持專業精神，iPasslabs 自今年起正式加入 IBTA（InfiniBand Trade
Association）技術生態系，並於今年 6 月參與 43rd InfiniBand™ and RoCE Plugfest，作為投入高速
Scale-Out Networking 技術驗證的起點。未來將積極參與 InfiniBand、RoCE、Ethernet 與 Scale-Out Network
架構相關技術研討、Plugfest等活動，加速建立AI 網路驗證能力。 憑藉多年高速介面驗證經驗，iPasslabs
提供涵蓋
Ethernet、InfiniBand、光通訊與電性整合測試的完整解決方案，從訊號完整性（SI）模擬分析、Pre-Test 與
正式Interoperability驗證，協助客戶有效降低設計風險、突破高速傳輸瓶頸、縮短開發時程並加速產品上市。且
作為 IEEE、PCI-SIG 與 IBTA 的會員及工作小組參與者，iPasslabs
長期實際參與國際技術標準推進與生態合作，嚴格依循協會規範與最新測試要求，提供值得信賴的一站式驗證服務
。 在這場AI 基礎設施競賽中，iPasslabs 致力成為客戶最可靠的高速互連驗證夥伴，攜手產業迎向 AI Data
Center 的新世代挑戰。

### [iPasslabs 開始提供PCIe® 5.0 32.0 GT/s 官方驗證服務][60]

作者： mkt • June 12, 2026
市場上仍有許多產品持續部署於 PCIe® 5.0
平台，也越來越多產品重視驗證階段，更能證明其效能的可信度跟產業競爭力。
為協助客戶加速驗證流程、不受限於時間地點，身為 PCI-SIG®認證實驗室的 iPasslabs，現正式擴展 PCIe® 5.0
32.0 GT/s 官方驗證服務能力。 自 2025 年正式成為亞洲第一家 PCI-SIG® 認證實驗室，iPasslabs 已提供
PCIe® 4.0 與 PCIe® 5.0（最高至 16.0 GT/s）官方驗證服務。如今，我們進一步支援 PCIe® 5.0 32.0 GT/s
正式驗證測試，協助客戶從 Pre-test 到 Official Compliance Test更順利完成驗證流程。 同時，PCIe® 6.0
也正式進入官方認證時代。自 PCI-SIG® Compliance Test Workshop #140 起，PCIe® 6.0
產品報名官方認證測試。然而，在正式認證之前，Pre-test重要性比以往更加關鍵。PCIe® 6.0 導入PAM4
訊號技術，大幅提高驗證複雜度，對於訊號完整性、互通性以及測試 know-how 都提出更高要求。
憑藉豐富的客戶 DUT 正式驗證支援以及參與 PCI-SIG Compliance Workshop現場測試的實務經驗，iPasslabs
擅長協助客戶降低開發風險、提升認證效率，加速產品上市。
[
][61]

### [iPasslabs 正式加入 IBTA!][62]

作者： mkt • June 12, 2026
在人工智慧快速發展下，資料中心進化為支撐生成式 AI、大規模模型訓練與高速推論的「算力工廠」。
隨著網路互連架構由 400G、800G 持續邁向 1.6T，高速互連（High-Speed
Interconnect）已成為影核心關鍵。如何確保高速網路互通性、訊號完整性與系統穩定性的品質，已成為產業升級
的重要課題。 秉持專業精神，iPasslabs 自今年起正式加入 IBTA（InfiniBand Trade
Association）技術生態系，並於今年 6 月參與 43rd InfiniBand™ and RoCE Plugfest，作為投入高速
Scale-Out Networking 技術驗證的起點。未來將積極參與 InfiniBand、RoCE、Ethernet 與 Scale-Out Network
架構相關技術研討、Plugfest等活動，加速建立AI 網路驗證能力。 憑藉多年高速介面驗證經驗，iPasslabs
提供涵蓋
Ethernet、InfiniBand、光通訊與電性整合測試的完整解決方案，從訊號完整性（SI）模擬分析、Pre-Test 與
正式Interoperability驗證，協助客戶有效降低設計風險、突破高速傳輸瓶頸、縮短開發時程並加速產品上市。且
作為 IEEE、PCI-SIG 與 IBTA 的會員及工作小組參與者，iPasslabs
長期實際參與國際技術標準推進與生態合作，嚴格依循協會規範與最新測試要求，提供值得信賴的一站式驗證服務
。 在這場AI 基礎設施競賽中，iPasslabs 致力成為客戶最可靠的高速互連驗證夥伴，攜手產業迎向 AI Data
Center 的新世代挑戰。
[
][63]

### [iPasslabs 與 BitifEye 宣佈達成策略合作夥伴關係，為高速訊號介面提供全球授權測試實驗室服務][64]

作者： mkt • October 13, 2025
此次合作專注於 PCI Express® 和 MIPI A-PHY® 一致性測試，為全球客戶群提供官方認證驗證服務。
艾飛思科技（iPasslabs Technology Co. Ltd.）與 BitifEye Digital Test Solutions
GmbH共同宣佈建立策略合作夥伴關係，攜手擴大服務範圍，為全世界提供高速訊號介面的官方認證測試服務。為滿
足全球 AI 和 智慧汽車（Smart Vehicle） 生態系統日益增長的需求，此次合作初期將專注於 PCI Express 和
MIPI A-PHY，並計劃在未來擴展至 USB®、IEEE/OIF 及其他新興技術。
透過結合雙方在測試系統開發、自動化和測試服務方面的互補專長，該合作夥伴關係將透過兩家公司的全球網絡提
供正式的認證測試服務。總部位於德國的 BitifEye 與總部位於臺灣的 iPasslabs
將共同推動全球業務發展，提供認證測試實驗室 (ATL) 服務。 iPasslabs 共同創辦人兼執行長 Eric Shen
表示：「為回應全球人工智慧技術的趨勢，我們很榮幸能宣佈這項合作，它將打破地域限制，為雙方創造雙贏局面
。透過與 BitifEye 的合作，我們現在能夠接觸並為更廣泛的歐洲客戶提供 PCIe 測試服務。同時，藉由
BitifEye 的專業知識和優勢，我們也能使 iPasslabs 的測試服務更加全面，從而提升公司的價值。」
在維持最高技術標準的條件下，此次合作為擴大專業能力範疇奠定了堅實的基礎，並克服了以往的限制。客戶將受
益於：更快的上市時間
(time-to-compliance)，以及更好的區域可及性，特別是首次將此官方認證服務擴展至歐洲，是經由PCI-SIG及MIP
I協會的認可，值得信賴。 BitifEye 執行長兼共同創辦人 Alexander Schmitt 表示：「與 iPasslabs
的合作使我們能夠服務更多的全球客戶。BitifEye iPasslabs Test Services Europe
GmbH是雙方共同新成立且聯合經營的測試實驗室，位於德國Böblingen，並結合 iPasslabs
在亞太地區的據點，使我們能夠為全球的 PCI Express 和 MIPI A-PHY
的需求提供高品質的測試解決方案和專業知識。」 關於BitifEye BitifEye 數位測試解決方案有限公司成立於
2005
年，總部位於德國斯圖加特附近，是高速訊號介面實體層接收器測試領域公認的市場領導者。該公司提供專業的自
動化測試解決方案，並積極參與定義最新互連訊號技術的國際標準化委員會。 BitifEye 開發的 ValiFrame
測試自動化軟體和相關的測試配件，可與 Keysight Technologies (是德科技) 的儀器無縫整合。BitifEye 和
Keysight
共同提供高度自動化的應用特定測試系統，被半導體和消費電子公司以及獨立測試實驗室使用。BitifEye
深入理解數位匯流排標準，並提供適用於 PCI Express®、Serial ATA®、SAS、USB®、HDMI®、DisplayPort®、MIPI
M-PHY®、MIPI D-PHY®、MIPI C-PHY®、UFS®、汽車乙太網 (Automotive Ethernet)、MIPI A-PHY®
等的一致性和相容性測試產品。 BitifEye 是歐洲唯一經授權可提供 PCIe 4.0 和 5.0
一致性測試的認證實驗室，此服務是與 iPasslabs 合作提供。
如需更多資訊請造訪：https://www.bitifeye.com/ 關於iPasslabs 艾飛思科技股份有限公司 (iPasslabs
Technology Co., Ltd.)，是由一群高速訊號測試領域服務多年的專家在 2021
年成立，位於台北市內湖科技園區，專精於提供各種高速訊號介面測試服務、訊號完整性分析模擬(SI)服務、電源
完整性分析模擬(PI)服務以及 Wilder Technologies Test Fixtures
代理銷售及相關技術諮詢。此外，艾飛思科技積極與 PCI-SIG 協會合作，擔任 PCI-SIG
研發工作小組重要工作夥伴之一，並於2025年6月正式成為PCI-SIG的PCIe認證實驗室(Authorized Test Lab)。
艾飛思科技於 2022 年開始銷售自有品牌 PCIe 5.0 高速測試治具，也於 2025 年 6 月正式銷售 PCIe 6.0
各種測試治具及 DataCom 通道模擬板，產品設計、零件及製造皆完整依照 PCI-SIG 及 IEEE 802.3 的規範。

## What is the Japan Rail Pass?

The Japan Rail Pass (JR Pass) is a single ticket that gives you **unlimited train travel.**

It is widely regarded as the **best and easiest way** to travel around Japan by train, saving you
money with affordable prices.

The JR Pass is exclusively available to visitors to Japan from overseas and covers journeys across
all of Japan train network. It includes the famous **[Shinkansen bullet trains][48]**, airport
transfers, and even buses and certain ferries.

You can choose from 3 types of JR Pass: **7, 14 or 21 days**. You can also get a [Green Pass][49] to
upgrade to first class.

[Buy your Japan Rail Pass][50]
[JR Pass Validity][51]
[JR Pass Prices][52]

## How it works

Order online

[Order your JR Pass][53] online in seconds right here.

Receive your exchange order

Have your exchange order sent to the address of your choice with our worldwide [delivery][54]
service.

Exchange order for the JR Pass

Swap your exchange order and activate your JR Pass in a [JR Exchange Office][55] located at any
major JR station in Japan.

Start your Japan experience

Catch as many JR trains, buses, and transfers as you like with your multi-use JR Pass.

## Frequently asked questions (FAQ)

### Is the JR Pass worth it?

If you’re **planning to visit different parts of Japan** during yourtrip, the JR Pass is definitely
worth it.

The JR Pass lets you make **as many journeys by train as you want,** including routes between major
cities like Tokyo, Kyoto,Osaka, and Hiroshima.

For all these trips you only need **1 Japan Rail Pass ticket,** that's right, no visiting the ticket
booth or rescheduling during your trip!

More information in our FAQ
**[When is the JR Pass worth it?][58]**

### Can I buy the Japan Rail Pass in Japan?

No, you cannot purchase the JR Pass in Japan.** You must order it online** and then collect it from
an [Exchange Office][59] when you arrive.

More information in our FAQ
**[Can I buy the Japan Rail Pass in Japan?][60]**

### How long will it take for my JR Pass to arrive?

We pride ourselves on **quick delivery.**

The exact time **will depend on your location,** but you’ll likely receive your order within 48
hours if you live in the US, UK, Canada, or Europe.

If you live in an isolated area of a large country, such as parts of Australia and Brazil, it may
take longer. However, it is **unlikely to take longer than 96 hours/4 business days.**

More information in our FAQ
**[How to make seat reservations?][61]**

### What is included in the Japan Rail Pass?

The Japan Rail Pass is valid on:
* Shinkansen high-speed trains
* JR Express and local trains
* JR Local buses
* Airport transfer trains to Tokyo and Osaka international airports

transfers, and even buses and certain ferries.

# Compliance Consultants for Accreditations & Audits – JVR Consultancy

As one of the UK’s leading experts in compliance accreditations and audits – and with a 100% success
rate – JVR Consultancy is renowned for providing exceptional, tailored solutions to businesses of
all sizes across the UK and globally. Our long-serving consultancy is focused on supporting your
business achieve and retain your chosen accreditations.

Our dedicated industry consultants work relentlessly to develop, implement, and support high-
quality, fully integrated management systems that ensure your organization remains compliant,
efficient, and prepared for any challenge. With JVR Consultancy, experience unparalleled service and
watch your business soar to new heights of success.

## [Achilles BuildingConfidence][171]

[Achilles Building Confidence Consultants]

We offer a range of [Achilles accreditation][172] including [BuildingConfidence][173], [Rail][174],
Transport, [TransQ Global][175], [UVDB][176], and [FPAL (Oil & Gas) Scheme][177]. We are supporting
you with a free gap analysis.

[Achilles Rail RISQS - JVR Consultancy]

## [Achilles UVBD][179]

pink, and purple, forms a stunning homepage backdrop. The structures stand tall, carrying cables
across the landscape. In the background, additional infrastructure is visible under the colorful
sky.]

We are Achilles Utilities UVDB Consultants. We are here to help support your company achieve the
necessary UVDB qualification.

[The image showcases the UVDB Verify logo, featuring the text "UVDB Verify empowered by Achilles" in

blue. Ideal for enhancing SEO on your Homepage with verified credentials.]
[UVDB Qualification][180]

[A modern high-speed train travels rapidly along railroad tracks, with a bright sunset in the
background. The train's sleek design and motion blur emphasize its fast speed, fitting perfectly on
a website's homepage. The scene conveys a sense of efficiency and progress.]

Our rail compliance specialists have in-depth knowledge of the product codes and the requirements of
the Core Module and can advise the best course of qualification for your company.

[Logo for RISQS (Railway Industry Supplier Qualification Scheme). The letters "RISQS" appear in

written below in smaller text on a dark background, signifying its industry accreditation.]
[RISQS Consultants][182]

LMI Technologies is a global leader in smart vision solutions, delivering advanced scanning and
inspection for manufacturing. Powered by Gocator® 3D sensor and 2D camera hardware and on-device

decision-making at the edge—supported by a customer-driven approach that ensures fast deployment,
reliable operation, and 100% quality control.

inspection for manufacturing. Powered by Gocator® 3D sensor and 2D camera hardware and on-device

decision-making at the edge—supported by a customer-driven approach that ensures fast deployment,
reliable operation, and 100% quality control.

## Notre entrerpise

[Monaco Blue Services][11], spécialiste de l’univers nautique, vous propose différents services pour
votre yacht, qui s’étendent de la peinture avec nos équipes expertes, à la classification, avec RINA

# Your partner for customized electric motors - trusted since 1927

As a German manufacturer, we offer individual motor solutions worldwide. Our quick adaptations and

Don't want to miss any news? Then sign up for our free [newsletter today][78]!

## Electric Motor Production for Industrial Plants

Powerful industrial motors - customized for your applications

MENZEL develops and manufactures large electric motors with an output of **up to 25 MW
**specifically for **demanding industrial processes**. Our motors drive e.g. cement mills, steel
rollers, mine fans, compressors,  or pump systems** worldwide.** Whether custom-made or our own
motor series with high levels of efficiency - we supply motors that are **precisely tailored **to
your technical requirements. 

## Technical Consulting and Motor Design

Electric motors precisely designed for your application

The **optimum liability** of an electric motor is only achieved through the precise design of the
entire drive system. With almost** 100 years of experience** and our own **engineering department**,
we precisely match the required drive components to each other. Our experts analyze the grid,
switch-on and operating conditions and **provide support** in optimally adapting our motor to your
application.

## Fast Solution Directly from Stock

Large motors up to 25,000 kW directy from the warehouse

MENZEL maintains one of the **largest stocks of large industrial motors** in Europe. We have both
three-phase asynchronous **squirrel cage motors, slip ring motors and DC motors** in a wide range of
sizes in stock at all times - including special designs. Our extensive warehousing concept and
our **flexible in-house processing** enable us to offer unique response times and individual
customization of stock motors.

## [MENZEL Electric Motors Production Range][79]
* [
  [Three-phase squirrel cage motor IC 411]
  
  Asynchronous squirrel cage motors
  
  75 kW - 25000 kW (25 MW)
  220 V - 13800 V

* [
  [Slip ring motor]

  75 kW - 20000 kW (20 MW)

* [
  [Customized electric motors]
  
  Special electric motors
  
  IP67 motors, Ex ec and Ex tc motors, crane duty motors, roller table motors, generators, rotating
  converter sets, drive systems and more
  
  learn more
  
  ][83]

## Customized Motor Solutions, Fast Replacement Deliveries, and Special Designs

Many of our customers come to us **when they cannot find a standard solution** or when a damaged or
obsolete motor needs to be replaced immediately. Thanks to a uniquely large motor warehouse and
flexible manufacturing processes, we offer:

✔ **Custom-made motors for demanding operating conditions** - including motor designs that are no
longer common today

✔** Fast availability worldwide** - we supply and install electric motors anywhere. On request, our
experts can carry out commissioning on site

✔ **State-of-the-art production & comprehensive quality testing** - we carry out all key processing
steps in our own motor factory - with state-of-the-art machines, our own welding shop, paint shop
and a highly specialized motor test field

Don't want to miss any news? Then sign up for our free [newsletter today][78]!

## Electric Motor Production for Industrial Plants

Powerful industrial motors - customized for your applications

MENZEL develops and manufactures large electric motors with an output of **up to 25 MW
**specifically for **demanding industrial processes**. Our motors drive e.g. cement mills, steel
rollers, mine fans, compressors,  or pump systems** worldwide.** Whether custom-made or our own
motor series with high levels of efficiency - we supply motors that are **precisely tailored **to
your technical requirements. 

## Technical Consulting and Motor Design

Electric motors precisely designed for your application

The **optimum liability** of an electric motor is only achieved through the precise design of the
entire drive system. With almost** 100 years of experience** and our own **engineering department**,
we precisely match the required drive components to each other. Our experts analyze the grid,
switch-on and operating conditions and **provide support** in optimally adapting our motor to your
application.

## Fast Solution Directly from Stock

Large motors up to 25,000 kW directy from the warehouse

MENZEL maintains one of the **largest stocks of large industrial motors** in Europe. We have both
three-phase asynchronous **squirrel cage motors, slip ring motors and DC motors** in a wide range of
sizes in stock at all times - including special designs. Our extensive warehousing concept and
our **flexible in-house processing** enable us to offer unique response times and individual
customization of stock motors.

Many of our customers come to us **when they cannot find a standard solution** or when a damaged or
obsolete motor needs to be replaced immediately. Thanks to a uniquely large motor warehouse and
flexible manufacturing processes, we offer:

✔ **Custom-made motors for demanding operating conditions** - including motor designs that are no
longer common today

✔** Fast availability worldwide** - we supply and install electric motors anywhere. On request, our
experts can carry out commissioning on site

✔ **State-of-the-art production & comprehensive quality testing** - we carry out all key processing
steps in our own motor factory - with state-of-the-art machines, our own welding shop, paint shop
and a highly specialized motor test field

✔ **Transparency & quality** - our customers are invited to follow the motor tests live on site from
a comfortable lounge

## Opening Wireless Markets

The future of regulatory compliance– reinventing testing
and certification through innovation.

## Why Work With
## MiCOM Labs^{®}

As MiCOM Labs continues to expand, we are poised to make an even greater global impact. Today’s
clients increasingly seek personalized experiences and are drawn to brands that align with their
values and foster meaningful connections. This evolving landscape places businesses like MiCOM Labs
at the forefront, offering a unique opportunity to stand out and lead with innovation and
customer-focused solutions.

### Wireless Modules

Does your product design include an integrated wireless module? If so, it might already be
pre-certified for FCC (USA), ISED (Canada), or EU compliance.

### CBRS Alliance & OnGo^{®}

MiCOM Labs is a CTIA-authorized Approved Testing Lab (ATL) for CBRS OnGo® certification. We can test
products leveraging the 3.5-3.7GHz frequencies for SAS conformity (WINNF-TS-0122) and FCC Part 96
certification.

### Independent Test Labs

For independent ISO/IEC17025 accredited labs that test products and issue test reports, MiCOM Labs
offers an online, cloud-based certification program and automated application review process for
FCC, ISED, MIC, RED and UKCA.

#### About Us

## Decades of Relentless Innovation

Founded in 2001 by Gordon Hurst, MiCOM Labs, a privately owned and family-driven business, has
emerged as a global leader in RF, Wireless, EMC, Safety testing and regulatory compliance
certification services. Built on a foundation of relentless innovation, MiCOM Lab’s vision has
always been to shape the future of wireless technology by providing cutting-edge, high-end
compliance solutions. Through its automation and certification strategies, MiCOM Labs® has redefined
the regulatory compliance landscape for manufacturers worldwide.

[quote-icon]
I met with the field maintenance crew of the Juneau Alaska International Airport to demonstrate my
product, Instant Road Repair (IRR). For my demonstration, I tried to bring the IRR up to a workable
temperature by using a forced air ceramic heater. The product did not perform well and overheated
40°F / 22°C above the maximum recommended temperature. It cost me the entire pallet of material, and
I was very embarrassed. Since then, I use the Powerblanket tote heater.
Vern Fiehler
Quick Road Repair, Alaska
We didn’t have the time to wait out the winter for the temperatures to become more moderate. The
Powerblanket concrete heating blankets played a critical role in keeping us on schedule and not
having to postpone the pour on major Kansas City bridge.
Dale Helming
Project Manager, Massman Construction
I had a customer that needed product, and in the oil and gas industry, he needed it yesterday! I
contacted Powerblanket, and they responded to my special custom order quickly and effectively. They
designed, manufactured, and shipped my product within 2 days, meeting my customer’s deadline and
preventing their product from damage and freezing in the cold temperatures. I was impressed with
Powerblanket’s representatives, as well as their responsiveness and ability to understand my urgent
need for the custom blankets.
Guy Blasingame
National Manager, Field Operations, ChemRock/Rapid Drilling
We are extremely satisfied with the switch to Powerblanket drum heaters. Powerblanket’s unique
technology allows our containers of coatings and materials to heat evenly and quickly, opposed to
band heaters, which concentrate heat in one spot have charred our product--sometimes contaminating
the entire container and rendering it unusable. Their barrel heaters protect the entire container
from ambient conditions, maintaining optimal operating temperature. In fact, our customers
successfully operate in the extreme cold conditions of North Dakota in uninsulated trailers thanks
to Powerblanket drum blankets. They use considerably less power than band heaters, have temperature
control capability, and are a top quality product.
Mike Roberts
Manager, Howard Marten Fluid Technologies

contacted Powerblanket, and they responded to my special custom order quickly and effectively. They
designed, manufactured, and shipped my product within 2 days, meeting my customer’s deadline and

We are extremely satisfied with the switch to Powerblanket drum heaters. Powerblanket’s unique
technology allows our containers of coatings and materials to heat evenly and quickly, opposed to
band heaters, which concentrate heat in one spot have charred our product--sometimes contaminating
the entire container and rendering it unusable. Their barrel heaters protect the entire container
from ambient conditions, maintaining optimal operating temperature. In fact, our customers
successfully operate in the extreme cold conditions of North Dakota in uninsulated trailers thanks
to Powerblanket drum blankets. They use considerably less power than band heaters, have temperature
control capability, and are a top quality product.
Mike Roberts
Manager, Howard Marten Fluid Technologies

## About Us

We operate as a diverse local business providing rail plant maintenance services. With expansive

As a registered authority for approvals with all the various networks available within Australia,
ProRail prides itself on its flexibility and ingenuity in engineering equipment to suit desired
needs.

## [Certification][28]

In the highly regulated Australian rail industry, maintaining compliance is crucial to ensuring the
safety of passengers and workers. With the goal of preventing derailments and injuries, Rail
Infrastructure Managers have established registers for every piece of rail maintenance machinery.
However, keeping and maintaining these registers can be a daunting task for local government
departments.

To help with the registration and compliance process, the government has appointed competent persons
to assist and achieve these goals. ProRail is proud to be a registered Independent Competent Person
(ICP) for many networks across the country. Our extensive portfolio of competencies covers a wide
range of networks, making us one of the few providers in Australia that can match our capabilities.

As ICPs, we are authorized to certify any track maintenance vehicle for use on a multitude of
networks across the country, including major networks such as ASA (NSW City), ARTC (National), MTM
(Melbourne City), V/LINE (VIC Regional), DPTI (SA), ARC INFRASTRUCTURE (WA Regional), TAS RAIL
(TAS), PTA (Perth City), JH RAIL (John Holland Job), and AURIZON (QLD Regional).

Let ProRail help you ensure compliance and safety in the Australian rail industry. Contact us to
learn more about our comprehensive competencies and our ability to sign off and certify any track
maintenance vehicle for use on a wide range of networks.

## [Road Rail Vehicles][30]

For any road vehicle that has been manufactured or modified to operate on rail, the owner and/or
operator of the vehicle shall obtain an engineer’s certification, validating the design,
construction and/or installation of the rail guidance equipment and associated modifications, and
shall provide evidence of a documented maintenance and inspection regime for the vehicle, in order
to gain approval to operate on the any network.

certify it all for use on rail. Or maybe fit an supply a tilt rotator for the new hi-rail excavator.

Give us a call and we can talk you through the process.

# Frequently Asked Questions

### How do I book train tickets on RailYatri?

To book a train ticket, enter your source and destination stations along with the journey date.
Choose from the list of available trains, select your class and seat preference, enter passenger
details, and complete the payment. You will receive instant booking confirmation and PNR.

### Can I check PNR status on RailYatri?

Yes, you can easily check your PNR status by entering your 10-digit PNR number on the PNR Status
page. RailYatri provides real-time updates about your booking status, berth confirmation, and coach
position.

### Is Tatkal ticket booking available on RailYatri?

Yes, RailYatri supports Tatkal and Premium Tatkal bookings. Log in at 10:30 AM for AC classes and
11:30 AM for sleeper class bookings. Availability is limited, so try booking as early as possible
within the Tatkal window.

### How does the Seat Availability feature work?

The Seat Availability feature helps in making the entire train travel easier and convenient. All
that our users have to do is enter the Train number, the source and destination, the class and quota
accompanied by the date of Journey. The app will tell the number of seats available for the
waitlisted tickets and the chances of getting the confirmed tickets for the train they have desired.

### What is Confirmation Probability?

Confirmation Probability means what is the chance of your ticket getting confirmed. So whether you
have a waitlist PNR or trying to book a waitlist ticket, RailYatri's Confirmation Probability tells
you exactly what are the chances of this ticket getting confirmed. We categorise the waitlisted
number into 3 categories - High, Medium, Low (using a confirmation probability algorithm). That
helps you in knowing your chances of getting a confirmed ticket.

### Why the need for RailWisdom™?

For anyone who has traveled in India (especially using the Indian Railways network) know about the
variability associated with each and every town/station/train in India. We do not have the uniform
structure/facility/accessibility at our railway stations; or the uniform Yellow Cabs™ waiting
outside our stations; or the same uniform McDonalds™ or Pizza Hut™ located in each and every of our
towns.

Such variability brings in complexity from a traveler's perspective; however also adds to the
charm/expectations of the unexplored town or taking a new train. We believe that travelers are keen
to know and be ready to experience these diversities. Variations also bring in possibilities. And
these possibilities are sometimes best explained through the experiences of other travelers. We
refer to such experiences as “Wisdom”.

RailWisdom™ is a collection of travel wisdom provided by the people by virtue of their experiences
and delivered to other travelers using a technology medium (maps, mobile, etc.) in a location
sensitive and contextualized manner.

### Can I cancel or modify my train ticket?

If you booked through RailYatri, you can cancel your ticket under the My Bookings section before the
trains chart is prepared. Modifications are not allowed — you must cancel and rebook.

### How can I track my refund?

Tracking your refund is very easy with RailYatri. You can track your refund status both through
RailYatri's app and web page

#### Through App:

Once you cancel your order/ticket, you will receive notifications in your app regarding cancellation
and refund initiation along with an e-mail. We would also be sending the Tracking ID, Transaction
Reference Number and Contact Number of our payment gateway. You can track your status using the
tracking details sent to you.

#### Through Web:

You can also track the status of your refund at : [http://refunds.railyatri.in][48] Type in your
order id, order type and mobile number. Your refund status will be sent to you.

### Does RailYatri offer customer support for bookings and refunds?

Yes. You can contact customer support via the app or website for help with bookings, cancellations,
and refunds. You can also track refund status at: [http://refunds.railyatri.in][49]
